description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You begin a Strike against a creature your Feral Bond can see.

Your Feral Bond assists your attack even without repositioning.

Your Feral Bond harries the target from wherever it stands. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the triggering attack roll. Your Bond need not be adjacent to the target, and need not have prepared to Aid.

cinderfall.incomplete: Even setting the cross-creature sourcing aside, the predicate needed is a three-way relation ("my companion can currently see my target") — no roll option expresses a second creature's line of sight to a third creature. This effect buffs, protects, or grants actions to the Feral Bond (the companion beast) from the holder's own card. No rule-element selector in pf2e-source lets one actor's item grant a stat bonus, temp HP, an extra action, or a shared sense to a different actor's sheet -- confirmed by spot-checking real pf2e's own fully-built Animal Companion subsystem (Ranger/Druid), where virtually every companion-buff/companion-action-economy feat ships with rules: [] too.
